div.p: TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure) is the total number of calories your body burns in a day, including your basal metabolic rate (BMR) and your daily activity level. This estimate can help you plan calories for fat loss, maintenance, or muscle gain.
The formula commonly used is based on standard BMR equations that estimate your resting calorie burn, then multiply by an activity factor to estimate total daily expenditure.
